chores.note: What each chore costs and trains, read by the actions system (game/farm/systems/actions.gd, farm-actions spec). base = the cost before skills, tools, the season and buffs (a number, or the path of a number written elsewhere); cat = the energy category (rules/10-farming.json gather, field, ...); mult = a second modifier that multiplies the energy after the rest (optional; the old snow and weed code did this, kept so no number moves), raw = no skill, tool of the trade, season or buff changes the energy (optional; the party and the visit; a `mult` still applies), round = up rounds the energy up to a whole number and min is the least it can be (optional; the village trip), wear = the polish that wears, practice = the skill family that trains (both optional). A recipe at a station is one chore, recipe: its energy, inputs and water are read from recipes.json (this file only says it is a chore) through the chore's profile in crafting.gd. The forest's trips cost no energy of their own (the question each way is asked by the interface), a look at a spot costs none, and the other tasks of a spot cost the gathering energy. A chore that works on a stretch of patch (weed, stones) or on a number of animals names its amount in code: the base energy is per unit. Other cost kinds that depend on the call (the water of a planting, the feed of the animals) come from code too. The effect of a chore stays in the system that owns it. The progression explorer reads water.fetchEnergy, which is why fetch_water points to it.

moments.note: How much of a step a chore takes (rules: action-budget). A chore's own `moments` is 0 (free: walks that already cost a Time Quiz question, and looking), 1 (light), 2 (middle) or 4 (heavy); a recipe writes "energy" and takes its moments from its own energy by these bands (energy up to the first number gives that many moments). A step holds perStep moments plus chapterExtra for the chapter being played (chapter 1 first; free play keeps the last), set from the bot's natural use per step (about its 75th percentile: 18, 21, 26, 32 …); skill ranks take moments off (rules/48-skills.json momentsPerRank). Counted only in actions.gd.
